verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator installed from npm. It runs locally against your own Git checkout and keeps its Ledger data in Git-native records with local views, so the core product runs on user-controlled infrastructure. However, nothing explicitly documents self-hosting as a deployment mode or confirms that no vendor-hosted service is required. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting documentation or a statement of no cloud dependency, an open-source license or source-build instructions, and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-run deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, repeatable workflows, and receipt-backed repository changes.
Keep task intent, status, blockers and responses in Git-native records.
Serve bounded local views without exposing a mutation API.
code, notebooks, notes and Ledger in one Git checkout.
